site.title: Multilingual Service Finder in Japan
site.description: Search medical, legal, housing, and daily life services in Japan in your language.

home.lead: Find multilingual services such as clinics, visa consultation, housing and mobile phones by area and language.

search.empty: No services match your search. Try changing the conditions.
search.error: Could not load services. Please try again later.

detail.error: Could not load this service. Please try again later.
detail.reportListing: Request a correction or removal of this listing

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Questions about the site or listings? Send us a message and we will reply by email.
contact.name: Name
contact.sent: Thank you. Your message has been sent.
contact.invalid: Please check your name, email and message (up to 2,000 characters).
contact.rateLimited: Too many messages. Please wait a while and try again.

apply.title: Apply for a listing
apply.lead: Businesses that support foreign residents can apply to be listed. We will review your application and contact you by email.
apply.requiredHint: * Required. Please enter the service name and description in English at least.

apply.invalid: Please check the required fields (category, prefecture, languages, English name and description, contact person and email).
apply.error: Could not submit your application. Please try again later.
apply.inviteLoaded: We have filled in the details from our invitation. Please check and correct them (especially the supported languages) before applying.
apply.inviteInvalid: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Please fill in the details to apply.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or may have been moved.

optOut.title: Unsubscribe from listing invitations
optOut.lead: If you do not wish to receive listing invitations, press the button below. We will not send invitations to this email address again.
optOut.done: You have been unsubscribed. We will not send you any more invitations.
optOut.invalid: This link is invalid. Please contact us using the details in the email or the contact form.
optOut.error: We could not process your request. Please try again later.
